text:
1  SUPPORT FRAMES
Two Technic 5 x 7 frames
Hold the shafts in alignment

2  INPUT SHAFT
9L axle - connects to motor
Turns the first small gear

3  INTERMEDIATE SHAFT
7L axle - carries a 24T gear
and an 8T gear together

4  GRAY FULL BUSHES
8 shown - axle collars / spacers
Limit sideways movement

5  OUTPUT SHAFT
12L axle - drives the lift links
Turns slower with more torque

6  SMALL GEARS - 8 TEETH
2 gears: input and middle shaft
One is partly hidden in this view

7  LARGE GEARS - 24 TEETH
2 gears: middle and output shaft
Each pair gives 3:1 reduction

8  YELLOW HALF BUSHES
6 shown - thin axle spacers
Some sit behind the front frame
